name: SampleLog16ToSqrtBytes
signature: extern "C" const double mem_0092A278; // 0.0 (returned for zero magnitude) extern "C" const double mem_0092A270; // 1.0 extern "C" const double mem_00999A68; // 256.0 struct SampleLog16Source
summary: Decodes `count` sign-magnitude log16 codes from arg0->samples and stores each as a byte: sqrt(v)*256 for 0<v<1, 0 for v<=0, 255 for v>=1.
